喜欢希腊神话而来的，游戏剧情很贴近希腊神话原著，并且梳理了时间顺序，制作组应该查阅了不少资料。 战斗也有点当年日式战棋RPG的感觉，不同的只是那是回合制，这个是即时制。 卡牌立绘总体来说中等偏上水准，有些画的很好，有的又比较一般。 操作上有点像CR，但这个更偏重于PVE，不用那么氪金去打天梯啥的，相对比较休闲。 卡牌的趣味性尚可，有时能发现一些意外的战术，例如主角可以推着金羊毛移动，这样就能一直享受它的神光治疗。 有些卡牌感觉比它的品质要强，例如投石车，感觉比一些紫卡还强，完全就是人海克星。。。 作为一个国产小团队制作出的游戏，已经相当不错了，表示一下支持。

[h1]向日葵游戏评分：5分（1-10）[/h1] 这款即时战术游戏结合了卡牌的玩法，游戏模式只有单人战役，剧情以希腊神话为背景，本体免费但只能玩前三章。 游戏简化了卡牌元素，只保留了兵种卡和法术卡，玩法仍是以即时战术为主。目前游戏的平衡性不是很好，有的卡很强，有的卡太废。游戏的物理引擎需要优化，目前经常出现把单位挤飞和推着走的BUG。 [h1]欢迎大家关注我们的鉴赏家：https://store.steampowered.com/curator/28763059[/h1] [h1]关注微信公众号和头条号“向日葵游戏”获取更多资讯；官方微博：向日葵游戏评测[/h1]

Card collecting to form your army, while following the fabled storylines of your characters journey though the distinctive maps which make up the small battlefields where you will fight to gain exp and upgrades to your collection. Although some maps can be very tight for your different types to place, they will push themselves into place as the cards become available thru mana growth, and you grab and put them on the battlefield. Cards have varing tendicies, some will charge ahead, others slowly march forward, and others will hold back to protect a hero (your character) on the map, whose death will cause an immediate loss. You dont control them, just their placement origionally on the battlemap. You can have rogue cards that when put down will only go after the oppositions hero if possible. Some card creatures are humanoid giants, sea monsters, archers, spearmen, or monkey heros, and also fabled monsters, like harpies and medusa, and many are animals like lions and elephants, magical to imaginary, there are lots to collect. Its a fun game and has lots a replayabilaty, hopefully the A.I. of your cards will shine a bit better, but overall its quite good. mobile lines show heavily, but I'll let that go. Also I dont quite understand when I can have total control over which hero and deck I chose for a battle as it seems somewhat locked right now.

"Gods and Kings" is an abandoned attempt at making a medieval/fantasy RTS/card battler hybrid, which might have a lot of promise, but the way the developer has misleadingly priced this product to scam gamers, and the way they abandoned it almost immediately after launch (presumably without refunding anyone naive enough to pay for the full game) should be enough to warn gamers away from this bug riddled, incomplete and abandoned product. The developers abandoned this 5 years and 11 months ago. It will never be completed. This unfinished game is just polluting Steam and making it harder for gamers to find genuinely, completely made games. The graphics in this game are passable, but could be better. And while it's vital for any game to have impressive visuals (gaming is a visual medium, after all), there's more to a game than just the graphics. To be worth a gamers time, the game must match top tier visuals with top tier gameplay, and that's not happening here. On pricing and value for gamers, this isn't really free as you're expected to pay up more money to unlock content/DLC so you can keep playing. This is some nasty, predatory pricing and PC gamers don't like it. The developer has their hand out a $11 USD DLC to unlock the full game... this is the wrong way to price a game, and while Valve lets developers do it, it's ultimately bad for gamers. If they want to try sell their game with a free demo, there's a formal, less misleading way to do it, but the developers here chose deliberately not to follow the correct course of action. Even though this is "free", it failed to appeal to the 120 million+ gamers on Steam. SteamDB showed the game peaked at just a dozen or so concurrent players, and now there's basically nobody playing it. Even though it's free. This is a dismal public reception, but it's easy to see why gamers rejected it. Bearing in mind that free games don't add +1 to your game collector count, should you bother adding this to your library and downloading it? Nope. This isn't worth downloading. While this didn't cost me any money up front, I still feel ripped off.
